audit_timeliness.description: Proportion of audit reports delivered on schedule
audit_timeliness.justification: Percentage directly represents proportion. Range 0-100 is standard. Higher is better for timeliness.

audit_efficiency.description: Average duration taken to complete an audit
audit_efficiency.justification: Audit durations usually span days. 1-365 days covers all reasonable annual audits. Lower duration means higher efficiency.

error_rate.description: Number of discrepancies identified in audit reports
error_rate.justification: Measured as a count per report. >50 errors implies a fundamentally broken report, treated as invalid data.

agency_scale.description: Composite score based on team size and years of operational experience
agency_scale.justification: Composite index 0-100 weighting size (capped at 100) and experience (capped at 20 years) equally.

compliance_adherence.description: Level of adherence to established auditing standards
compliance_adherence.justification: Compliance is naturally evaluated as a percentage of requirements met.

past_renewal_status.description: Historical record of empanelment renewals and revocations
past_renewal_status.justification: Ratio of renewals to total decisions. Sparse history (<2 decisions) is insufficient for a reliable ratio.
